policy.scope: Exact sealed C28 source artifacts against frozen O main bc7ca298 only. Status is coverage in that O snapshot, not global novelty. partially_tested means adjacent O mechanism/evidence/control structure without the exact matched implementation/evaluation; uncovered means no sufficiently close O mechanism or matched test.

assessment_details.rationale: O has no matched CPO tied-parameter protected-index/reference prepartition, ZeRO-3 rank-local auxiliary-state transport equivalence test, or measured sparse-state memory path.
O has monitor/recovery policies and uncertainty-aware strategy changes, but no matched genealogy-triggered cooldown experiment or particle-filter alarm duty-cycle validation.
O already compares protected-risk versus expected-time/resource cost, but has no matched fixed-beta particle reserve benchmark under transient allocation stress.
O uses held-out/independent evidence and scoped uncertainty, but has no online/strongly-adaptive conformal residual-width layer or frequency-vs-one-step safety test.
O uses confidence, contradictions and source freshness to modulate actions, but has no matched genealogy-localization risk budget or particle-resampling controller.
O freezes exact request/model/executor bindings and has replay authorization boundaries, but no matched forward-only deterministic replay authorization facade with pre-score determinism contract.
O has versioned durable execution/evidence bindings, but no matched allowlisted runtime-provenance contract registry across historical/v1/replay-v2 admission surfaces.
O has fail-closed recovery and exact provenance checks, but no matched version-aware compliance auditor that forces score failure and disables reconciliation on runtime-provenance mismatch.

O's Context Kernel rechecks critical authority and action constraints immediately before dispatch, closely overlapping the final-effect stale-admission failure class, but HALO's exact obligation/token test is not reproduced.

O has dependency-bound context/effect manifests and fail-closed invalidation, but no matched typed heterogeneous-output partial-retention graph comparing whole-response rejection versus independent filtering.
O binds authorization to semantic effect/action identity rather than only named tools, but lacks a matched permission-bypass benchmark across equivalent mutation primitives.

O explicitly separates architecture/configuration from executed evidence and requires exact-head CI/readback, but has no matched protocol-spec versus pinned regression-matrix audit like the OpenPort case.

O tracks source invalidation and context-derived authority, but has no matched browser tool-metadata injection/lifecycle-revocation experiment covering tool name, description and residual conversation content.
O binds effects to action manifests and bounded user authority, but has no matched trusted-boundary approval renderer or empirical approval-decoding coverage frontier.
O already uses structured next actions, evidence receipts, effect identity, idempotency and recovery, but has no matched conventional-CRUD versus agent-first API interface experiment.
O has pre-effect safety checks and monitor/recovery gates, but no matched every-action safety-review ON/OFF experiment measuring solved-to-unsolved disruption by model capability.
O has durable checkpoint recovery and logical context resets, but no matched identical-failed-prefix joint context+environment rewind experiment with target-selection and memory factored separately.
O considers protected-regression risk and evaluator value, but has no matched Jeffreys posterior LCB/UCB destructive-correction gate whose evidence requirement scales with blast radius.
O has no matched generative latent source model crossing volatility/stochasticity with explicit correlated-observation families or held-out semantic-reversal measurements.
O records contradictions and can abstain/fail closed, but has no matched cross-observation-family semantic-invariance posterior requiring agreement across plausible generative families.
O has durable journals, idempotency and replay, but no matched rotating-event-log tri-state FOUND/ABSENT/UNKNOWN persistence query with platform-specific stable snapshots.
O uses version-qualified evidence and exact source binding, but has no matched Lean Attempt/Terminate router reproduction; C601 mainly updates an external numeric result.
O uses expected-time routing and bounded actions, but has no matched binary current-target next-attempt oracle analysis separating that oracle from richer controller action spaces.
O tracks outcome evidence and resource cost, but has no matched learned verifier-grounded trajectory router using normalized similarity/error-diversity features and explicit marginal-cost scope.
O preserves reversible incumbents/candidates and rollback while exploring challengers, but has no matched two-phase theorem-proving baseline-preservation plus optional MCTS experiment.
O uses held-out/protected regression and accepts negative evidence, but has no matched preregistered incremental-over-baseline normalized logistic with OOD abstention and bootstrap stability vote.
O optimizes information value and protected-regression risk, but has no matched evidential-bias adaptive design objective that directly penalizes misleading-evidence lower-tail risk.
O allocates among heterogeneous methods/providers using expected-time evidence, but has no matched learned low/high-fidelity discrepancy model with state-dependent escalation ratio.

O has candidate proposal/evaluation, held-out boundaries and durable evidence, but no matched four-surface EXPLORE/TUNE/CERTIFY/OUTER protocol with candidate-local e-process certification, exposure budget and cross-candidate LORD accounting.
